Compared with other GP practice's I have been to in the past Archwood is by far the best, by miles. Looking at the 'bad reviews' if you fancy switching to my previous GP's, ill be more than happy to suggest afew. Then you can compare.

I for one feel fortunate to have such a good GP surgery. I have  always found the behind the scene team, fantastic, helpful pleasent etc. Can't fault them. They have always been helpful when booking appointments, passing information to Doctor/Nurse. I have even had a member of the admin team ring me the day after I called booking an appointment that was just out of the diary range the day previous - you cannot beat that!.

You always get reminders when 'this or that' is due i.e. Flu jab ( and probably the Covid Jab in future!) The Pharmacist does regular check ups to keep you on track and this is before you even get to the doctors!

All the doctors have been excellent. I really cannot find fault with any of them. Even had a Dr sort an appointment out whilst I was sat in the room and  they have even rang back late evening. Like I say reading the other reviews all I can say is that I must have had some 'right shockers' in the past!!!

All, the Doctors are great but Dr Fitton probably wont thank me for saying this ( as everyone will be booking to see her) but she is a fantastic Doctor. Willing to listen, explores every avenue and as you expect caring, but thats saying more of her as a person than a Doctor  .
